list.title: Exams
list.subtitle: Schedule exams, record results, and review performance.

empty.title: No exams yet
empty.description: Schedule your first exam to get started.

confirmStart.title: Start this exam?
confirmStart.description: Once started, the exam's details and subject list can no longer be changed — only results can be recorded.

confirmComplete.title: Complete this exam?
confirmComplete.description: Results can no longer be changed unless the exam is reopened.

reopenDialog.title: Reopen this exam?
reopenDialog.description: Provide a reason — this is recorded in the audit log.
reopenDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Marking error found in Mathematics
reopenDialog.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reopen a completed exam.

toasts.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

subjects.empty: No subjects added to this exam yet.
subjects.lockedNotice: The subject list is locked once the exam has started.

confirmRemove.title: Remove this subject?
confirmRemove.description: It will no longer be examined as part of this exam.

toasts.error: Could not update this exam's subjects.

results.chooseSubjectPrompt: Choose a subject to record or review its results.
results.notOngoingNotice: Results can only be recorded while the exam is ongoing.
results.empty: No students enrolled in this class for this academic year.
